title: NC65销售发票保存提示自定义2字段超长
problem: NC65销售发票保存提示自定义2字段超长
cause: 客户此字段内容需求过多，需要调整
solution:
-- 【修改元数据字段（需要重启服务器）】: 请先备份再进行更新操作
-- 【备份】：
create table md_property_backup_20230901 as select * from md_property
create table md_column_backup_20230901 as select * from md_column
-- 1更新表头元数据
--1.1
select id from md_class where name='ia_i5bill' --i58ae7e1-0edf-4b7e-9aea-c203215f2bb4
--1.2
select id from md_property where classid='i58ae7e1-0edf-4b7e-9aea-c203215f2bb4' and name='vdef2' --i56552d7-3e88-420e-bbfb-598713e6f871
--1.3
update md_property set attrlength=500 where ID='i56552d7-3e88-420e-bbfb-598713e6f871'
--1.4
select ID from md_column where id like 'ia_i5bill@@@%' and name='vdef2' --ia_i5bill@@@vdef2
--1.5
update md_column set columnlength=500 where id='ia_i5bill@@@vdef2'
-- 2更新明细表元数据
--1.1
select id from md_class where name='ia_detailledger'--8ca7c90e-036a-4ea5-a4cf-9b858594b7c2
--1.2
select id from md_property where classid='8ca7c90e-036a-4ea5-a4cf-9b858594b7c2' and name='vdef2' --8290d99e-8d18-4f23-9387-ff408dd6c0b2
--1.3
update md_property set attrlength=500 where ID='8290d99e-8d18-4f23-9387-ff408dd6c0b2'
--1.4
select ID from md_column where id like 'ia_detailledger@@@%' and name='vdef2' --ia_detailledger@@@vdef2
--1.5
update md_column set columnlength=500 where id='ia_detailledger@@@vdef2'
-- 3更新相关表的字段
alter table ia_i5bill modify vdef2 varchar2(500)
alter table ia_detailledger modify vdef2 varchar2(500)
alter table IA_HISDETAILLEDGER modify vdef2 varchar2(500)
